_comment: Machine-specific Claude Code settings. Copy to .claude/settings.local.json (git-ignored) and
replace the paths with your real product repo locations — the same paths you put in
This file exists so the committed .claude/settings.json stays valid in every clone.
Absolute paths never belong in a shared settings file: a deny rule for a path that does not
exist on this machine protects nothing, and additionalDirectories pointing at a missing
directory just fails. Nothing here is required to run the framework — add it when you want
the agents to read your product source for /analyze-code.
Delete the _comment key before use; Claude Code ignores unknown keys but it is noise.
